label: Late in episode, rises with S1 belief at GO, after reward, and after a2->S1 rare at D2.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * belief_lo * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (state - action) * ep_trial ;; (phase != D2) * prev_reward * ep_trial
terms: (phase == GO) * belief_lo * ep_trial**2 ;; (phase == D2) * (common == 0) * (state == S1) * ep_trial**2 ;; (phase == D2) * (common == 0) * (state == S2) * ep_trial**2 ;; (phase == D1) * prev_reward * ep_trial**2 ;; (phase == GO) * prev_reward * ep_trial**2 ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * ep_trial**2 ;; (phase == D2) * prev_reward * ep_trial**2 ;; (phase == D1) * tv("reward", -2) * ep_trial**2
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 18 is dominated by timing (it ramps from about -0.95 toward 0 over the episode; timing R^2 0.90). The residual is small and its trial-dependent effects grow with episode time, so all terms are multiplied by ep_trial. At GO it rises with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (a1-leaning). At D1/GO it is higher after a rewarded previous trial. At D2 it reflects the transition just seen: higher after a rare a2->S1 and lower after a rare a1->S2 (state - action). The short form scores 0.23 on test, about 81% of the free fit (0.29) and near the additive ceiling (all = 0.29). Scaling by ep_trial**2 instead of ep_trial and splitting out patterns (a1 S1 r at GO, reward two trials back at D1) improves the free fit. Most of the remaining variance is drift that differs between episodes late in the episode, and no observed cue captures it.
